components.name: Silicon Die (SoC Chip)

components.name: Package Substrate
components.reasoning: The organic substrate that provides the physical platform for mounting the silicon die, connecting it electrically to the external pins. It is a separate manufactured assembly from the die and is commonly procured from specialized suppliers.

components.name: Ball Grid Array (BGA) Solder Balls
components.reasoning: These solder balls form the electrical and mechanical interface between the package substrate and the smartphone PCB. They are considered part of the package assembly but are often procured and handled as a distinct component in the packaging process.

components.name: Encapsulation Mold Compound
components.reasoning: The molded plastic covering that protects the silicon die and substrate from mechanical and environmental damage, formed as a discrete manufacturing step in the packaging process.

components.name: Thermal Interface Material (TIM)
components.reasoning: Material placed between the die and the package lid or heat spreader to improve heat dissipation; it may be procured separately as a specialized component in some packaging solutions.

components.name: Package Lid/Heat Spreader
components.reasoning: A metal or ceramic lid that protects the die and assists in heat dissipation. It is a distinct physical component procured separately and assembled during packaging.

components.name: Wire Bonds or Flip-Chip Bumps
components.reasoning: Electrical connections between the die pads and the package substrate, manufactured components but often procured as assemblies or specialized services, distinct from die and substrate.

components.name: Underfill Material
components.reasoning: Polymer material injected under flip-chip bumps to provide mechanical stability and protect connections. It is a distinct assembly material in the packaging supply chain.
